rationale: Motor vehicle collision causing comprehensive damage to the policyholder's vehicle and injury to the policyholder; this is clearly an auto claim.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15am yesterday; the other driver was traveling ~35 mph with no braking and the collision caused the policyholder's vehicle to be totaled (crushed trunk and back seat). The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report and other driver's insurance information are available.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by another vehicle traveling at approximately 35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat; vehicle totaled
case_facts.other_driver_at_fault: yes; police report filed with other driver's insurance information

rationale: Damage to the policyholder's vehicle (hood and windshield crushed by a falling tree) is a comprehensive auto loss, regardless of whether the tree originated on the policyholder's own property.
claim_summary: Policyholder's maple tree fell in windstorm and struck parked vehicle in driveway, crushing hood and windshield. No structural damage to home. Estimated medium-range repair costs; $1,000 deductible applies.

case_facts.description: maple tree from policyholder's front yard fell in wind and landed on parked car
